text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
異様にガラの悪い連中が下の酒場に
居座っちゃって、いきがってるんだよ。
text.official_en:
Thugs! They're infesting the tavern down below.
What's this city coming to, I ask you?

text.jp:
酒場は階段を下りた先だけど、
絶対に近寄らないほうがいいよ。
text.official_en:
It's right down the stairs. You can't miss it. But if
you ask me, you should do just that—miss it!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
マジーデの奴が暴れて
店の物を勝手に持ってっちゃったんだ。
text.official_en:
Look out for Majide... He's been running amok lately.
He even stole from my stall!

text.jp:
あいつのことを知らないのかい？
この街の支配者気取りのごろつきさ。
text.official_en: That thug! Struts around like he owns the place.

text.jp:
悪い方に有名な男でね、よく悪さして
捕まって牢に繋がれたりしてるよ。
text.official_en:
He's a bad apple. Gets caught, they throw him in the
dungeons. Gets out, ends up back in.

text.jp:
最近、うさんくさい連中とつるんで
大剣闘祭で優勝してやるって気を吐いてるよ。
text.official_en:
Fell in with a new crowd lately. Scoundrels all! He
keeps bragging he's going to win the games too.

text.jp:
そういや、最近さらに凶暴になった気がするね。
たまり場にされてる酒場の親父が困ってたよ。
text.official_en:
He's grown bold and cruel. The owner's at his wits'
end, with these ne'er-do-wells stinking up his tavern.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ついこの前もダロスって戦士がマジーデに
やられたんだが、ひどい有様だったよ。
text.official_en:
Just the other day, Majide beat a warrior called
Dallos within an inch of his life.

text.jp:
一命はとりとめたものの、それ以来
影に異様に怯えるようになってしまって……
text.official_en:
Ever since then Dallos has been jumping at
shadows!

text.jp:
全くもって不気味な話さ。
マジーデは何をやったんだろうね。
text.official_en:
The whole thing gives me the creeps. What did
Majide DO to the poor fellow?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにしてもさ、本っ当に
呆れるくらい人が多い街だね、ここ。
text.official_en:
I can't believe how many people there are in
this city!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ああ、エスメラルダは
ダグシオンに来たのは初めてなんだね。
text.official_en: Oh, right. It's your first time in Dagsion, isn't it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ、あたいは生まれも育ちも
辺境ひとすじの漁師の娘だからね。
text.official_en:
Yeah. I've lived my whole life in the tail end of
nowhere. I'm a fisher's daughter, after all.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえば……あたしも田舎から出てきた時は
あんたみたいな感じだったかもしれないね。
text.official_en:
You remind me of when I first came to the city, now
that I think about it.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp: 試合は<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: Your match will take place on <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
私には貴方の考えは理解できませんし、
その試みがうまくいくとも思えません。
text.official_en:
I cannot comprehend your thinking. Nor can I
imagine this will go well.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
知っていますか？　なんでも力で解決
しようとする発想、それを野蛮と呼ぶのです。
text.official_en:
This notion that everything can be solved through
strength...it is called barbarism. Think on that!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それにしてもダーリン、都会ってのは
なんかさ、思ってたよりもすごいんだね。
text.official_en: This city is AMAZING! Don't you think so, Sweetie?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これだけの街だから、大剣闘祭の参加者も
そこら中にいるかと思ったけど、案外いないね。
text.official_en:
But we're not having much luck finding a competitor
for the games, are we?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ま、このまま地道に続けてれば、
そのうち誰かに当たるだろうしね。
text.official_en:
Oh well! If we keep looking around, we'll bump into
somebody sooner or later.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
帝都ダグシオン……これまでも
幾度か訪れたことはありましたが――
text.official_en:
Dagsion, the imperial capital. I have been here before
on occasion. Each time, the same thought strikes.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まともな機械すら扱えぬ獣たちがこれほどまでの
都市を造り上げたことは驚嘆に値します。
text.official_en:
These beasts, who have no technology, have built a
remarkable metropolis—a praiseworthy feat.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
これは、地上に築かれた
獣たちの驕りの都といったところでしょうか。
text.official_en:
It is a towering edifice to indulgence only the
surface world could hold. Yes, I shall leave it at that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
タリムーンと、つい最近出来た
ヴァンダル商会セント・メリーダ支部について、
text.official_en:
Talimun and I were supposed to have a meeting
about the Saint Merida branch.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
色々と相談する約束をしていた筈なのですが……
一向に戻ってくる気配がありませんね。
text.official_en:
*sigh* But, as always, the slightest hint of mundane
business, and he's made himself scarce.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウーシュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……仕方がありません。貧民街のあたりに
人を派遣して探させるしかなさそうです。
text.official_en:
If I know him at all, he's likely dawdling in lowtown.
I'll have to send someone to drag him back.
text.real_en:
If I know him at all, he's likely dawdling in the slums.
I'll have to send someone to drag him back.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
よう、お前さんか。
相変わらず、水も滴るいい男ってか。
text.official_en:
Well, speak of the devil himself! Looking sharp
as always, my friend.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……あの件、よろしく頼むぜ？
<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
I trust you'll take care of business. Meet me here on
the <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ん？　ウーシュラが俺様を探してたって？
……そういや、なんか忘れてたかな……
text.official_en:
Hm? Ursula's looking for me? Ha! Now that you
mention it, it did feel like I was forgetting something.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
――！？
あなたもここに来ていたのですか。
text.official_en: Oh?! You've come here too?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
警告しておきます。
僕たちには関わらないでください。
text.official_en: I warn you not to involve yourselves with us.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アナトリア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ヴリトラに与するあなた達は、
僕たちの敵なのですから。
text.official_en: You are affiliates of Vritra, our enemy.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……へえ、おまえもここに来てたとはな。
ってことは当然、大剣闘祭に出るんだよな？
text.official_en:
Huh, never expected to see you here. So, you're
entering the Heroic Games?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ナジャ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おもしれえじゃねえか。なら、この間の
決着はそのうちアレーナで付けてやるぜ。
text.official_en:
Now this is interesting! Looks like we'll be settling
our score in the arena.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ひ……ひいいいいっ！？　あなたはもしかして
この間の滅茶苦茶怖い人っ！？
text.official_en: Ahh! You're the scary person from before!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ハルヴィン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あ……でも、さすがにこんな街中で
突然切りかかっては来ない？　もしかして？
text.official_en:
You, uh, wouldn't maybe go and cut someone down
in the street? Would you?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: て……手前はあの時の……！？
text.official_en: Y-you're that guy from that other time!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
クソが！　このマジーデ様の大活躍の場を
まんまと奪いやがってよ……！
text.official_en:
You stinkin' cheat! How dare you rob me, the
great Majide, of my big chance?!
text.real_en: Damn it! They went and stole this Majide-sama's big chance to shine...!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
覚えてやがれ！　そのうち背筋が凍るような
嫌がらせをしてやるからな！
text.official_en:
Just you wait! One of these days I'm gonna
GET you—and get you BAD!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヨーカイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
先ほどからこちらを見ているようだが、
それがしに如何な用件かな？
text.official_en:
I noticed you observing me a while ago. Have you
need of me in some way?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……行くとしましょうか。
再び、闘技場の受付へ。
text.official_en: Let us head to the arena.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの女の言っていたことが真実かどうか、
確かめてみれば分かるでしょう。
text.official_en:
We need only speak to someone to find out whether
that woman from the tavern was telling the truth.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ま、私はこの話が嘘だったほうに
羊塩乾酪を賭けてもいいですよ。
text.official_en:
I would willingly stake a ration of salted sheep's milk
cheese that her words were a mere prevarication.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここいらへんの雰囲気は
あたいは別にキライじゃないかな。
text.official_en: You know, I like it around here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
これはこれで都会って感じがするし、
桟橋で船眺めるのも楽しいし。
text.official_en:
It's still PART of the city, but you can head to the
docks and watch the boats come and go.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういえば上の連中ってさ、ときどき
妙に気取った奴に当たることあるんだよね。
text.official_en:
This city is full of heavy-handed people who like to
throw around their authority, though, isn't it?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あたい、話してる相手のことを
見下してくるヤツって許せないんだよね。
text.official_en:
If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who look
down on you for no good reason.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
こういう安宿ってのはまあ、
安いだけでも有り難いと思っとかないと。
text.official_en:
The lodgings here are rough and ready, but at least
they're cheap.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まあ……あたしも金が必要な身の上さ。
贅沢なんかしている余裕はないしね。
text.official_en: I'm trying to save money, so I'll put up with it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど、寝床に虫が住み着いてるのだけは
さすがに我慢ならないね。
text.official_en: But I draw the line at bedbugs.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あまりにも腹が立ったから、宿中の
敷布を全部天日に干しておいてやったよ。
text.official_en:
The moment I spotted one, I made sure they aired
out the bedding. Nothing does the trick like sunlight!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ひゃあ、あんた、ぶったまげるくらい
綺麗な顔してるねえ。
text.official_en: My word, but you're beautiful.

text.jp:
なんだい、見てると
俺まで変な気分になってくるよ。
text.official_en:
Don't know what it is, but I can't take my eyes
off you...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
このお兄ちゃん……
なんだか……怖い……
text.official_en: You're so scary!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ねえ、貴方、
もしかしてダグシオンは初めてかしら？
text.official_en: Is this your first time in Dagsion?

text.jp:
すごい街でしょう？
ここは、神様が造った、地上の楽園よ。
text.official_en:
Impressive, isn't it? It is no less than a paradise
created by the gods.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
さっき酒場の通りを奥に歩いてった奴って、
まさか、あいつじゃないか？
text.official_en:
I saw a guy sauntering down the street outside the
tavern. I'm pretty sure I recognized him too.

text.jp:
ここじゃしばらく見かけなかった気がするが、
……いつの間にか戻ってきてたのか。
text.official_en:
It's been a long time since I've seen him around.
When did he get back into town?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
この先の路地でなんかスゲエのを見たんだ。
もうジャラジャラしてて金持ちっぽいんだよ！
text.official_en:
A super-rich guy just walked past me, right down
the alley. He was wearing so much jewelry!

text.jp:
あの真っ赤なおっさん、絶対ただ者じゃないぜ。
何か探してるみたいだったけど……？
text.official_en:
Dressed in bright red, like some kind of king! I think
he was looking for something.
